title: Altias's Horse Colors
description: Tweaks vanilla horses and adds more colors to feel more like real horses!
body:
As a certified Horse Girl, some of the horse colors in Minecraft always bothered me. And it always felt like so many were missing. This resource pack aims to fix that without completely remodeling vanilla horses.

Most of my upates are accuracy tweaks. Black points on bays, appaloosa spots that aren't perfectly uniform, things like that. By using the white horse coat overlayed in the shape of markings, they blend far better into the fur rather than looking like stickers slapped on. I also adjusted the saddle a little bit, as it did not look like a saddle at all.

Without ETF, you'll get my updated/tweaked vanilla horse colors. But if you add ETF, you'll get a bunch more coats added to the game! A bit more variety in horses, and no more common colors glaringly missing! 

Fresh animations version of this is in progress, it mostly works but the white tail markings dont swish right and you lack the animated eyes. Once I figure out the tail thing I'll upload a version that works properly with it.
